justifications.clinical.clinicalOutcomes: Injury prevention and symptom reduction at the workstation well-documented; RTW facilitation reduces disability duration.
justifications.clinical.efficiency: Variable certification (CEAS, CPE); online to multi-day formats; moderate cost.
justifications.clinical.caseloadApplicability: Applicable in occupational health, work injury, and disability settings; limited in traditional clinical rehab.
justifications.clinical.reimbursement: Ergonomic and FCE assessment codes exist; workers compensation is primary payer; significant WC billing opportunity.
justifications.clinical.marketDemand: Steady demand in occupational health, corporate wellness, and workers compensation settings.
justifications.clinical.patientSatisfaction: Workers value intervention that targets their specific job demands; employer-funded model reduces patient burden.
justifications.business.cashPayViability: B2B corporate contracts pay well; direct consumer cash-pay is limited.
justifications.business.pricingLeverage: Project-based billing supports good margins, especially in tech/finance corporate clients.
justifications.business.marketDifferentiation: Many providers offer ergonomic assessments; CEAS is common.
justifications.business.ownerLeverage: Easy to scale via contracted assessors; strong B2B leverage model.
justifications.business.marketDemand: Employers drive demand more than consumers; moderate overall.
justifications.business.efficiency: Short, affordable certification (e.g., CEAS I-III); quick ROI.
justifications.academicClinical.facultyRecognition: Modest standing; relevant in occupational health/OT programs but not a promotion driver.
justifications.academicClinical.scholarship: Decent ergonomics and human factors literature exists.
justifications.academicClinical.teachingValue: Fits OT curricula and PT industrial/work conditioning content well.
justifications.academicClinical.evidenceDepth: Reasonable evidence base in MSD prevention, mixed in office settings.
justifications.academicClinical.facultyDemand: Occasionally preferred in OT faculty postings emphasizing work/productivity.
justifications.academicClinical.efficiency: Short course, reasonable academic teaching utility.
